title: School subscription
subtitle: Activate ShuleOS for your school so fees, attendance, and parent updates stop living in separate spreadsheets.
lockedSubtitle: Your school is approved. Subscribe to unlock the full platform before another term starts without a system.
activeSubtitle: Manage the card on file, invoices, and cancellation in the Stripe billing portal.
exemptSubtitle: This school has platform access without a self-serve subscription.
notManager: Ask a school admin or finance officer to complete payment.
notConfigured: Online checkout is not connected yet. Contact ShuleOS support to activate your school.
canceledToast: Checkout canceled. You can subscribe whenever you're ready.
